messages:
maya-pr: Heads-up — two analyst briefings requested for launch week. Ardent Research wants Fri 09:30 PT (virtual). Delta Analytics asked for Mon 08:00 PT and requested an embargo until Mon 16:00 PT. Need: Jonas availability, a short bench summary, and final quote. Can we confirm timeline?

alex-g: I can own the tech deck + demo flow. Will sync with liam on benchmarks.

liam-product: I have the perf numbers ready but need to vet them with legal. Key bullets: median p50 latency 28ms (seq len 128), 3x throughput improvement vs baseline on our 8-GPU pool, and estimated 40% token-cost reduction from batching+KV cache in our tests. I'll paste raw sample below.

liam-product: ```
Benchmark: 8-GPU pool, model: rw-large-v2, seq=128, batch=16
Median latency: 28ms
99th pct: 190ms (with cold KV)
Throughput gain: 3.0x vs baseline
Cost delta: -40% token cost (simulated workload)
Test id: perf-2025-03-14-03
```

sophie-legal: Do not share internal test IDs publicly. We need sources for each # (test id or link to run). Also change any wording that implies we "guarantee" cost savings — use "observed" or "typical". Fact-check window: 48 hours is ok. Send the raw logs to legal@redwood so we can sign off.

maya-pr: Copy. Draft embargo and suggested Jonas quote below. Please review edits. Fact-check to close 48 hours pre-embargo.

maya-pr: ```
EMBARGO: Please hold until Mon 2025-03-31 16:00 PT
Outreach plan: Ardent (Fri 09:30 PT briefing), Delta (Mon 08:00 PT briefing)
Fact-check window: 48 hours
Suggested Jonas quote: "Our mission is to make inference predictable and economical — these results show the potential of smart serving to cut costs and improve latency for product teams."
```

olivia-marketing: For inbound lead routing: create a press-specific lead tag in SF and route all analyst+press leads to AE_queue_press. We'll add an origination field: "analyst_briefing". Also plan a short follow-up webinar for customers the week after launch — can product commit to a 30-min technical deep-dive?

alex-g: Yes to the 30-min. We'll do a quick live demo + Q&A. Need 20 mins of slides and 10 mins for live API Qs.

jonas-ceo: Quick read: I like the quote but swap "potential" -> "real" and remove "cut" — maybe: "These results demonstrate how smart serving delivers measurable cost reductions and better latency for product teams."

maya-pr: Noted. Sophie — is Jonas' rewording okay legally?

sophie-legal: That wording is acceptable as long as the numerical claims are qualified ("observed in our tests" or "in our benchmarks"). Add a parenthetical pointing to the benchmarking methodology (link or appendix) in any press materials.

maya-pr: Will revise quote and embargo email, remove test IDs from public copy, attach methodology appendix link (internal only for fact-check). Action items: 
- maya-pr: send updated embargo + quote to both firms today and request 48h fact-check.
- liam-product: upload sanitized benchmark summary + methodology doc to drive and share link to legal & pr.
- alex-g: finalize demo script and deck.
- olivia-marketing: set SF lead routing and schedule follow-up webinar.
- jonas-ceo: hold 30 minutes Fri for Ardent (tentative).

calendar-bot: maya-pr added Ardent Research brief — Fri 09:30 PT — Jonas, alex-g, liam-product invited. Delta Analytics meeting created Mon 08:00 PT.

maya-pr: Thanks all. I'll post the finalized embargo email and the press Q&A doc here once legal signs off. Please react with :thumbsup: when you complete your item so I can track.

liam-product: Uploaded sanitized bench doc to drive at https://drive.redwood/infer/benchmarks/sanitized-perf-03-14 (shared w/ legal & pr).

alex-g: Deck uploaded: https://drive.redwood/infer/decks/ardent-briefing-v1 — please review.

maya-pr: Sophie — did legal get what you needed from the sanitized doc?

sophie-legal: Yes, we have what we need. Approved for factual claims: "median latency 28ms (observed in our tests, seq=128)" and "~40% lower token cost observed in our simulated workload". We still recommend the parenthetical linking to the appendix.

maya-pr: Perfect. I'll send the embargo note to reporters after I update the quote per Jonas and add the appendix link. Target send in 30m.

jonas-ceo: Good work — go ahead.

olivia-marketing: Routing set and webinar placeholder created. I'll sync with AE for list and follow-up sequences.

maya-pr: Closing thread for now — will reopen if any pushback from Ardent/Delta. :rocket:
